svg.title: Kiln render time by resolution
svg.desc: The same prompt and seed rendered at eight sizes with Anima, the turbo LoRA, 8 steps, Euler and NAG on a laptop GTX 1660 Ti 6 GB. 512x512: 7.8 s; 512x768: 11.7 s; 768x768: 18.6 s; 640x960: 20.1 s; 768x1152: 30.5 s; 832x1216: 36.3 s; 1024x1024: 38.1 s; 1024x1536: 63.7 s.
svg.text: Same prompt and seed · Anima + turbo LoRA, 8 steps, Euler, NAG on · laptop GTX 1660 Ti 6 GB · whole job, seconds
